generation.mode: single built-in ImageGen whole-canvas edit with edit-target.jpg first and the NinjaOne seed canon second as reference only

lightingIsotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by uniform-bin mean; delivered water-mask pixels and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lightingIsotropy.visualCheck: No coherent whole-cell cast-shadow direction is visible, but basalt caps and upper tree tiers are materially lighter than their vertical faces and lower foliage. The aggregate statistic does not prove literal equal-value lighting.

buildableVsSteepFraction.basis: manual full-frame screen-space estimate as fractions of non-water land at native source resolution
buildableVsSteepFraction.method: Open gently rolling meadow and accessible shelf ground count as buildable; exposed crag and inherited terrace faces count as steep; dense stands, scattered broken rock, talus, and the rune carving make up the remainder.
buildableVsSteepFraction.limitation: This is a visual screen-space estimate with approximate uncertainty of plus or minus 0.08 per fraction, not an elevation-derived slope measurement.

crown.method: Full-frame multiscale local-apex census of 844 discernible dark-green conifer crowns, retaining the narrow saplings rather than filtering them out; median source width 12 px scaled by 2560/1254 and converted at 0.048 m per final pixel.

waterMask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
waterMask.method: Native-resolution variable-width centre trace following the visible bank-to-bank water surface, including turquoise paint, pale wash, ripple highlights, and reflections; reviewed as a three-times nearest-neighbour magenta overlay.

runeChain.visualRead: The feature has a dark recessed centre and no standing column wall, but its continuous regular stone lips still risk reading as a lined kerb; human visual judgment remains required.

refusalReasons: The measured median crown is 1.176 m, below the required 1.7-5.2 m band; the dense western stand reads as a carpet of narrow saplings rather than proper mature crowns.
The literal flat-lighting rule fails visually because rock caps and crown tips are lighter than vertical faces and lower foliage.
The crowns retain internal light-dark tiering and the requested visible grey-blue haze is absent or too weak to soften their edges.

The generated beck reaches the south source edge near x=992 rather than the required handoff near the far eastern portion of that edge, and it begins in open ground instead of continuing through a wooded gully.
The rune groove reaches the east source edge near y=628 instead of the required y=652.08.
The south-east site reads as two detached flat-topped column stacks without a clear north approach ramp, not one coherent beacon crag.
openRisks: The rune feature is recessed and dry, but the long regular stone lips may still read as a lined kerb rather than a naturally weathered bedrock cut.
The water mask is mechanically binary, same-size, connected, and hole-free; exact bank placement remains a human visual gate.
No stitch, upscale, shipped-canvas bake, runtime mount, public asset promotion, or owner visual acceptance was attempted because this package is quarantine-only.
